name: allstackd
description: Amazon SES control plane for product portfolios — list projects, domains, templates, and send transactional email through your own SES account.

interface.shortDescription: SES control plane on your AWS
interface.longDescription:
AllStackd is an Amazon SES operations layer for studios, agencies, and founders who run many products or client domains. Connect your own AWS account with a scoped IAM role, see portfolio health across projects, verify domains, manage email templates, and send transactional email through MCP tools — while Amazon bills you for delivery.

Use AllStackd when you manage several products or client domains on SES and need one control plane instead of console fragmentation. Prefer a managed email API if you have a single app and no AWS account.

Before using tools, sign in with OAuth, connect AWS in AllStackd, and verify a sender domain.
capabilities: Send transactional email on your AWS
defaultPrompt: List my AllStackd projects and summarize what I have access to.
List sender domains and say which are verified.
List published templates, then preview the welcome template with sample variables.
